method.coverage: Every matching CSV and every row. No top-channel, anomaly-only or random sampling.
method.numeric_columns: All columns except event_id, channel and geometry; malformed numeric cells fail.
method.moments: Finite-value pooled mean and population SD, weighted by finite row count.
method.histograms: 32 shared per-metric asinh-spaced bins spanning the observed finite min/max across all channels. Exact counts in these bins, from a second full pass.
method.subrun_distributions: Quantiles of subrun medians, NOT pooled-event quantiles. Detailed within-subrun quantiles retained in raw_detail.npz.
method.time: Eight consecutive equal-file-count bins ordered by numeric subrun. Not elapsed time. Bin means weighted by finite row count.
method.presence: Observed channel events / observed events in that subrun; not external trigger efficiency. Absent-channel occupancy is zero, other measurements are unavailable.
method.missing: Nonfinite numeric cells counted, never replaced by zero. Absent subrun/channel measurements stay NaN in detail and null in JSON.
method.precision: Prompt numeric summaries rounded to 6 significant figures; detail arrays retain float64.
method.limitations: Not waveforms. Compression loses exact event order, arbitrary cross-variable correlations, within-bin changes, fine distribution shape and individual outliers beyond stated extrema. No supplied good raw reference: absolute values alone do not prove a fault.
